title: Gazetteer of Upper Burma and the Shan States Part I Vol I
author: J. P. Hardiman & Sir J. George Scott
genre: Encyclopedic Historical Gazetteer & Tai Philological Compendium
description: Monumental imperial gazetteer compiled by J. P. Hardiman and Sir J. George Scott (Government Printing, Rangoon) providing an exhaustive survey of the Southwestern Tai ethno-linguistic groups, the rise and fall of the Kingdom of Mong Mao (the ancient homeland of the Nora, Khamyang, and Ahom peoples), royal Tai chronicles, comparative dialect vocabularies, and social customs.

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ ၼႆႉ ပဵၼ် ပိုၼ်း လူင် ၶွင် မိူင်း မၢၼ်ႈ တွၼ်ႈ ၼိူဝ် တင်း မိူင်း တႆး
sentences.text_roman: pap nai pen pün lung khawng möng man tawn nü tang möng tai
sentences.assamese_script: এই বিশাল গেজেটিয়াৰখন হৈছে উজনি বাৰ্মা আৰু শ্বান ৰাজ্যসমূহৰ এক প্ৰামাণিক বুৰঞ্জী
sentences.free_translation_en: This monumental gazetteer documents the comprehensive history and geography of Upper Burma and the Shan States.
sentences.free_translation_as: এই বৃহৎ গেজেটিয়াৰখন উজনি ম্যানমাৰ আৰু শ্বান পাহাৰীয়া ৰাজ্যসমূহৰ এক অপৰিহাৰ্য প্ৰামাণিক দলিল।
sentences.speaker: Sir J. George Scott & J. P. Hardiman

sentences.lik_tai: မိူင်း မၢဝ်းလူင် ပဵၼ် ငဝ်ႈႁၢၵ်ႈ ၶွင် ၸၢဝ်း တႆး ဢၼ် ၽႄႈ ၵႂႃႇ လၢႆ တီႈ
sentences.text_roman: möng maw lung pen ngaw hak khawng caw tai an phae kwa lai ti
sentences.assamese_script: মোং মাও ৰাজ্যই হৈছে চাৰিওফালে বিস্তাৰিত হোৱা সকলো টাই জনগোষ্ঠীৰ আদিম গৃহভূমি
sentences.free_translation_en: The great realm of Mong Mao was the cradle and ancestral homeland of the dispersing Tai peoples.
sentences.free_translation_as: বিশাল মোং মাও ৰাজ্যই হৈছে অসম আৰু ম্যানমাৰলৈ প্ৰব্ৰজন কৰা সকলো টাই গোষ্ঠীৰ আদিম উৎসভূমি।
sentences.speaker: Gazetteer Historian
sentences.notes: Chapter on the Tai Kingdom of Mong Mao.

sentences.text_roman: caw fa sö ka fa luk ti möng maw se khaw ma möng a sam
sentences.assamese_script: স্বৰ্গদেউ চাওলুং চুকাফাই মোং মাওৰ পৰা যাত্ৰা আৰম্ভ কৰি পাটকাই পাৰ হৈ অসমলৈ আহিছিল
sentences.free_translation_en: Chao Lung Sukapha departed from Mong Mao and crossed the Patkai mountains into Assam.

sentences.speaker: Sir J. George Scott

sentences.text_roman: caw no ra pen caw an mi cü kaw kae nai pün tai
sentences.assamese_script: নৰা বা খাময়াংসকল হৈছে টাই ইতিবৃত্তত অতি মৰ্যাদাপূৰ্ণ আৰু প্ৰাচীন এক জনগোষ্ঠী
sentences.free_translation_en: The Nora people hold an ancient and venerable reputation throughout the chronicles of the Tais.

sentences.speaker: J. P. Hardiman

sentences.lik_tai: ၵႂၢမ်း လၢတ်ႈ ၶွင် ၸၢဝ်း တႆး မီး လွင်ႈ မိူၼ် ၵၼ် ၸဵမ် မိူင်း လၢဝ်း တေႃႇ ဢႃႇသၢမ်

sentences.free_translation_en: The spoken dialects of the Tai family exhibit remarkable genetic uniformity from Laos to Assam.

sentences.free_translation_en: Princes of the various states exchanged royal courtesies and jointly participated in sacred festivals.

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai alphabet possesses a beautifully rounded script that is exceptionally elegant and functional.

sentences.free_translation_en: Tai history continuously bears testimony to the indomitable resilience and fortitude of the people.

sentences.free_translation_en: May scholarly research concerning the Tai peoples continue to illuminate the academic world forever.
